trial_court: Family Court, Bemetara, District Bemetara in Civil Suit No.29-A/2016
case_name: Surabhi Singh Rajput vs Rupendra Singh Gautam
facts_of_case: Appellant filed an application to declare the marriage as a nullity, alleging abduction and forced signature on documents. Respondent claimed that the marriage was performed voluntarily. Trial court dismissed the application.

legal_principles.principle: To declare a marriage null and void, it must contravene any one of the conditions specified in clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of section 5.
legal_principles.held: Section 11 of 'the Act of 1955' describes 'Void marriages' which reads as follows:— Any marriage solemnised after the commencement of this Act shall be null and void and may, on a petition presented by either party thereto [against the other party], be so declared by a decree of nullity if it contravenes any one of the conditions specified in clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of section 5.
